newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp oil product stock rise.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp oil product stock rise.

text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Gasoline stocks rose as incoming barges and coasters outweighed departing cargo loads to NWE and across the Atlantic and barges leaving for Germany. Activity was brisk.
Naphtha stocks were also slightly up. Throughput was swift.
Gas oil stocks rose as some IPE delivery material was stored again. Additional material arrived from the former Soviet Union, while some left for Germany and Switzerland.
Fuel oil dipped as straight-run left for ARA and German use and the bunker sector absorbed cracked. Little arrived.
Jef fuel stocks changed little. A cargo arrived, but was fed into the gas oil pool. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5004
